title: Liber Collapsus: De Reditu per Collapsum et de Identitate Servata
version: Versio 2.0 — Editio altera, recognita et aucta (4 August 2026); first edition 11 October 2025

tier_1: Compact canonical statement of Reditus and of Axiom-0 (Collapsus generativus est; solum quod per collapsum redit, reale est) as a law of ontological admissibility; identity as continuity of structure able to return under the same rule, not immobility of words.
tier_0: Conditions under which Reditus may be tested: re-entry into an admissible region under the same declared contract; credit withheld where return is not demonstrated (fidem non tribuere ubi Reditus non demonstratur).

source_role: Active compact Reditus / identity / contract / seam / missingness / integrity language witness; local witness, not a tool to silently rewrite frozen technical runs (handoff manifest).
scope: Orders Reditus in brief mathematical and Latin form as a canonically ordered treatment and local witness; declares the object, exposes its own change from the 2025 edition, and states the rules by which Reditus may be proven.
non_goal: Neither closes the whole field nor substitutes the theory for the field; does not grant credit to the continuity between its own two editions, since that seam is not yet demonstrated.

missingness.item: Prior edition (2025) as a governing record
missingness.notes: The 2025 first edition is preserved by the source as historical witness, not the governing edition; it is not registered as a separate SR-GOV record, so supersedes is null.
Record 22310064 currently carries a different title; see SEAM-0010 and SRC-000018 missingness.

notes: The 2.0 edition states it replaces the 2025 form in active use (in usu activo substituit) while preserving it as historical testimony.
